config.purpose: register bounded newest-family continuation before policy scores

trial: T12 budget allocation, not a measured policy result
reason: Downloaded two-completion GRPO probe took 128.4 seconds/update. The four-hour SFT/GRPO cap may preserve SFT before completing the originally intended GRPO stage. Reserve quota for common-seed validation and held-out evaluation rather than assume 96 updates plus evaluation fit. This was a single-update probe with compilation overhead, not a measured steady-state speed estimate. Reassess against the active run before submission.

conditional_recipe.warm_start: frozen newest-family minimum teacher-loss SFT adapter; finish the registered 800-update SFT ceiling first if interrupted
conditional_recipe.data_partition: same 800 shuffled SFT states, 4000 disjoint GRPO states; preserve --sft-steps 800 --sft-batch 1 even when loading adapter
conditional_recipe.optimizer: resume the latest original GRPO checkpoint when one exists; otherwise restart explicitly from warm-start SFT
conditional_recipe.total_update_ceiling_if_resuming: min(96, checkpoint_global_step + 32); starting from SFT without a GRPO checkpoint gives 32 final updates

admission: Check official quota at submission; reserve active caps, planned final evaluation and startup overhead. Do not submit if remaining quota or reset deadline cannot cover the bound.
evaluation: Validation 80000-80099 then frozen test 200-399 per game; batch4 only after GPU validation. Report all available frozen checkpoints and retain all failures.
quality_stopping: This budget allocation does not count as a quality nonimprovement or establish exhaustion of Qwen3.8 capacity.

launcher.resume_details: Copy the immutable saved training core and retained SFT/GRPO checkpoints into their original absolute working paths. Reject incomplete optimizer checkpoints and a changed core hash. Finish SFT in a separate command with its original cadence, then run at most 32 further GRPO updates with saves every five. Preserve the preceding runtime plus each continuation stage runtime/log.
launcher.scheduler_note: Resumed GRPO retains optimizer/scheduler state but its cosine schedule uses the registered new total ceiling; this is an explicit bounded continuation, not the uninterrupted 96-step recipe.
